name: backpatch
title: Backpatch
description: A band theme built like a battle jacket — washed-denim ground, every show a black woven patch with a bone merrow edge sewn on slightly crooked, a red merrow on sold-out dates, the page text on one big bone back patch and rows of pyramid studs for rules — for metal, punk and hardcore bands on the road.

tokens.--font-sans: the one type family: body text, and in condensed black capitals the band name, page titles, city names and labels
tokens.--weight-display: how heavy the capitals of the band name, titles, city names and ticket tabs are
tokens.--text-s: small print: menu, dates, venues, status labels, footer labels
tokens.--text-l: intro lines, section headings in page text, quotes
tokens.--text-xl: city names on the patches, the band name on its name tape, post titles in the news list
tokens.--leading-tight: line height of capitals: titles, city names, the band name
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing of small capital labels
tokens.--color-bg: washed denim: the page ground (black denim in the dark scheme)
tokens.--color-twill: the darker twill lines that show only in the gutters either side of the page, and the dashed seam along the panel edges
tokens.--color-text: bone text on the denim: the menu, the shows heading, the footer
tokens.--color-muted: quieter text on the denim: the tagline under the shows heading, the footer description and labels
tokens.--color-accent: bleached-denim blue: the bar under the current menu item and the focus ring on the denim
tokens.--color-patch: the woven patches: show patches and the band-name tape (black woven; bone canvas in the dark scheme)
tokens.--color-weave: the weave lines, weft across and warp down, on the woven patches (a faint canvas grain in the dark scheme, where patches are printed canvas)
tokens.--color-patch-ink: lettering on the patches, and the bone ground of the ticket labels and the free-entry label
tokens.--color-patch-muted: quieter lettering on the patches: dates, the support line, status label edges
tokens.--color-thread: the bone merrow thread wound round each patch and the band-name tape
tokens.--color-sold: the red merrow round sold-out patches and the fill of the sold-out label
tokens.--color-canvas: the bone back patch that carries the page text, and the lettering of the sold-out label
tokens.--color-canvas-ink: text and the black merrow edge of the back patch: titles, body text, rules, quote bar
tokens.--color-canvas-muted: intro lines and table rules on the back patch
tokens.--color-link: links in the text of the back patch
tokens.--color-code-bg: background of code blocks on the back patch
tokens.--color-shadow: the shadow under every patch where it sits on the denim
tokens.--color-stud-hi: the lit facets of the pyramid studs
tokens.--color-stud-lo: the shaded facets of the pyramid studs
tokens.--measure: maximum width of a line of text
tokens.--page-width: maximum width of the denim panel
tokens.--space-m: base spacing: the gap under intro lines and around the footer, the skip link offset and the bottom of the denim panel
tokens.--space-l: spacing scale: between sections, and below each row of studs
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of patches, the back patch and the band-name tape (kept nearly square, as on a cut woven patch)
tokens.--radius-shaped: the rounder cut some patches have, as woven patches come in different cuts
tokens.--merrow: width of the slanted-thread merrow band round patches, the band-name tape and the back patch (wound thicker on sold-out patches)
tokens.--stud: size of one pyramid stud in the stud rows
tokens.--tilt: how crooked the patches are sewn on (each tilts this much either way)
